ETL Data Flow

End-to-End Pipeline Architecture

Step-by-step data engineering from mock ingestion to schema validation and relational analytics.

STEP 1

FastAPI REST Mock

Generates mock traffic stream with realistic latency, payloads, and timestamps.

STEP 2

Requests Pagination

Extracts 10 batches of 1,000 records with exponential retry backoff and paging cursors.

STEP 3

Pydantic v2 Invariants

Validates schema integrity, data types, and non-negotiable domain rules.

STEP 4

SQLite Storage

Stores verified records with primary keys and transactional ACID guarantees.

STEP 5

Pandas & Seaborn EDA

Computes aggregations and generates publication-quality figures across 7 objectives.

Constraint 1: Helmet Violations Exclusively restricted to motorcycles. Zero helmet fines permitted on 4-wheelers.
Constraint 2: Seatbelt Violations Restricted to cars, vans, buses, and commercial trucks. Prohibited for motorcycles.
Constraint 3: Financial Integrity Unpaid fines strictly enforced with PKR 0 collected revenue.

City-Wise Revenue Generation & Recovery Rate Performance

Objective 2

Enforcement Mechanism Performance Analysis

Comparative analysis of citation volume and payment recovery across Automated Cameras, Police Officers, and Speed Guns.

obj2_enforcement_efficiency.png Click image to enlarge

Original Chart Statistics: Enforcement Efficiency

Method Challans Assessed Recovery Rate
Camera 3,330 PKR 6.49M 71.2%
Police Officer 3,352 PKR 6.52M 69.5%
Speed Gun 3,318 PKR 6.51M 69.4%
Key Statistical Finding: Automated Camera systems achieved the highest individual payment recovery rate at 71.2%, exceeding manual officer stops (69.5%) and speed guns (69.4%), verifying high compliance with automated citations.
